title: Spec claims redact_token_route covers /reference/*, but the registry has no reference arm — capability tokens will ride access logs and Sentry events when rc3-3/rc3-4 ship the routes
detail: The diff's spec asserts a security control that does not exist. These helpers emit ~288-bit form/stop tokens in /reference/<token> URLs; when rc3-3/rc3-4 add the routes, tokens hit access logs and Sentry unredacted, and the false assurance makes the omission likely to survive.
recommended_fix: Add `["reference", ..] -> Ok("/reference/<redacted>")` to redact_token_route now (harmless before the route exists), or correct the spec line and pin the arm as an rc3-3 acceptance item.
